title: Federal adoption assistance - framework
facts: Federal Title IV-E adoption assistance can provide support for certain eligible children with special needs who are adopted from foster care, administered through state or tribal child-welfare systems.
Benefits and eligibility depend on federal requirements and the applicable state or tribal adoption-assistance agreement.
Adoption assistance can include recurring payments and Medicaid eligibility in qualifying cases, with program details varying.
Private domestic and international adoptions follow different legal and financial frameworks and should not be treated as Title IV-E adoption-assistance cases.
